title: FLUDARABINE-TREOSULFAN REDUCED INTENSITY CONDITIONING REGIMEN PRIOR HAPLOIDENTICAL STEM CELL TRANSPLANTATION WITH POST TRANSPLANTATION CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE FOR OLDER AND/OR FRAIL PATIENTS WITH AML
official: FLUDARABINE-TREOSULFAN REDUCED INTENSITY CONDITIONING REGIMEN PRIOR HAPLOIDENTICAL STEM CELL TRANSPLANTATION WITH POST TRANSPLANTATION CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE FOR OLDER AND/OR FRAIL PATIENTS WITH AML
summary: Main objective: to evaluate the efficacy of FT-RIC regimen before Haplo-SCT for older and/or frail patients diagnosed with AML, who are not eligible for a MAC regimen.

interventions.name: Fludarabine Teva 25 mg/ml solution à diluer pour injection ou perfusion
Trecondi 5 g powder for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1.	Patient with age between 60 and 75 years old; or aged 18-59 years if considered as ineligible for MAC regimen (as defined by the EBMT criteria20), because of HCT-CI ≥ 3;
2. 2.	Patients with AML according to the ELN202221 classification criteria requiring allo-HSCT (including the MDS/AML sub category •	AML in CR1 with intermediate or unfavorable risk according to ELN 2022 classification •	AML in CR1 with favorable risk according to ELN 2022 in case of positive minimal residual disease (MRD) •AML in CR2 or more (including patients treated for molecular relapse after a CR1)
3. Less than 5% bone marrow blast at the time of inclusion (i.e. CR, CRi, CRh, or MLFS after prior treatment, according to ELN 2022)
4. Allo-HSCT planed with a haploidentical donor;
5. Covered by a Healthcare System
6. Signed informed consent obtained prior to initiation of any study-specific procedures and treatment as confirmation of the patient’s awareness and willingness to comply with the study requirements.
7. ECOG<2 or Karnofsky Index ≥ 60 %
Exclusion criteria:
1. Left ventricular function < 40%
2. Pregnant women or those who may become pregnant (without effective contraception) or breastfeeding;
3. Adults under legal protection (guardianship, curatorship, or judicial protection);
4. Inability to comply with the medical follow-up of the trial for geographical, social, or psychological reasons
5. 4.	Liver enzymes ASAT and ALAT > 2.5 N
6. DLCOc < 40%
7. Acute promyelocytic leukemia
8. Patients treated with experimental drug in another clinical trial
9. Known hypersensitivity to treosulfan, fludarabine and cyclophosphamide and/or related ingredients
10. HIV-positivity
11. Previous allogeneic HSCT
12. Uncontrolled systemic fungal, bacterial, or viral infection (defined as ongoing signs/symptoms related to the infection without improvement despite appropriate treatment)
13. HBV or HCV hepatitis with a detectable viral load or any ongoing anti-viral Treatment
14. Other uncontrolled or active malignant disease.
15. Renal clearance < 50 mL/min
16. Any severe uncontrolled medical condition considered by the investigator as a contraindication for using treosulfan, fludarabine or cyclophosphamide
